title: Improved Constructive Lower Bounds for Small Hypergraph Ramsey Numbers
description: Explicit hypergraph colourings establishing R(4, 4, 4; 3) >= 100 (T_99 on Z_98 U {infinity} under G(98, 67)), R(5, 7; 4) >= 711 (G_710 on F_709 U {infinity} under PGL(2, 709)), and R(6, 6; 4) >= 685 (F_684 on F_683 U {infinity} under PSL(2, 683)), together with recurrence and stepping-up corollaries R(6, 7; 4) >= 3551, R(7, 7; 4) >= 21301, R(7, 8; 4) >= 149101, R(8, 8; 4) >= 1043701, R(13, 6; 4) >= 227201, R_6(5; 4) > 2^99, and R(12, 12; 5) > 2^684. Includes full manuscript (PDF/LaTeX), machine-readable JSON witness certificates with SHA-256 digests, search solvers, and zero-shared-code Rust and Python clean-room verifiers.
